# 📊 Featured Project

### Quantitative Pairs Trading Strategy

Built a pairs trading backtest for SGX-listed stocks using cointegration, backtesting, and machine learning

- Screened 66 pairs using Engle-Granger cointegration test.
- Best pair: **SingTel (Z74.SI) vs CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust (C38U.SI)**, p = 0.000229.
- Built a custom backtester with hedge ratio and transaction costs.
- Trained a Random Forest classifier (52.7% accuracy).
